# SourceBadge > Linked source badge with an automatic same-origin favicon, derived hostname, and resilient fallback. This file matches the installed `source-badge` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/source-badge.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/source-badge.md`. ## npm dependencies - `lucide-react@^1.78.0` ## Registry dependencies - `avatar` - `badge` - `core` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/badge-knobs`: `badgeKnobs`, types `BadgeKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/source-badge-knobs`: `sourceBadgeKnobs`, types `SourceBadgeKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/source-badge`: `sourceHostname`, `sourceFaviconHref`, `SourceFavicon`, `SourceBadge`, types `SourceBadgeProps`, `SourceFaviconProps` ## Composition ### Linked source The badge supplies its favicon automatically; SourceFavicon can also be used independently. ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { SourceBadge } from "@/components/control-ui/source-badge"; export function SourceBadgeExample() { return (
shadcn/ui MDN
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `source-badge` - `label` - `root`: `data-source-badge`, `data-source-badge-favicon` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### source-badge - `--cui-source-badge-background`: `var(--background)` - `--cui-source-badge-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)` - `--cui-source-badge-hover-background`: `var(--hover-fill)` - `--cui-source-badge-hover-foreground`: `var(--foreground)` - `--cui-source-badge-favicon-background`: `var(--muted)` - `--cui-source-badge-favicon-radius`: `var(--radius-sm)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/kits/source-badge - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/badge.json - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/source-badge.json
